title: An Iterator From Scratch

tests.name: basic iteration
tests.hint: for (int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2) yield return i;

tests.name: composition
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(string.Join(",", Solution.TakeEvens(Solution.EvensUpTo(100), 3)), "0,2,4", "early exit stops the source");
Cj.Eq(string.Join(",", Solution.TakeEvens(Solution.EvensUpTo(4), 10)), "0,2,4", "source exhaustion is fine");
tests.hint: foreach + a counter + yield return inside — early exit leaves the source half-consumed, which is the point.
